description.zh: 管控模块，用于匹配安全策略类型
description.en: Control module, used to match the security policy type.

description.zh: 管控子模块，用于匹配安全策略类型
description.en: Control sub-module, used to match the security policy type.

description.zh: **工作空间ID**，用于精确匹配工作空间级别策略
description.en: **Workspace ID**, used to precisely match workspace-level policies.

descriptions.zh:
## 请求说明
该 API 用于根据提供的管控模块、子模块及工作空间ID来查找最适合的安全策略。如果提供了工作空间ID，则会优先匹配指定工作空间级别的策略；否则，将返回租户级别的策略。请注意，系统策略不能被删除或修改。
descriptions.en:
## Request Description
This API is used to find the most suitable security policy based on the provided control module, sub-module, and workspace ID. If a workspace ID is provided, the policy at the specified workspace level is matched first; otherwise, the tenant-level policy is returned. Note that system policies cannot be deleted or modified.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dataworks-public find-best-match-security-strategy --control-module DataQuery --control-sub-module MyCatalog --workspace-id 12345 --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dataworks-public FindBestMatchSecurityStrategy --region cn-hangzhou --ControlModule DataQuery --ControlSubModule MyCatalog --WorkspaceId 12345
